technology.value: Go (go 1.26) backend; React 18 (TypeScript) front end in web/. usememos/memos.

run_command.value: `docker run -p 5230:5230 neosmemo/memos:stable` with a mounted data volume (README); or build from source (Go server + web/ React build).

host.evidence: README.md line 66 `-p 5230:5230`, line 71 http://localhost:5230; scripts/Dockerfile MEMOS_PORT=5230.

api_style.value: gRPC. Service definitions in proto/api/v1/*.proto (memo_service, user_service, attachment_service, shortcut_service, instance_service...) under package memos.api.v1, exposed over HTTP via grpc-gateway. gRPC is the native API.

auth.value: required for user-scoped actions. Username/password sign-in issuing a session token; API access via bearer access tokens. Public/anonymous read is possible depending on a memo's visibility setting.
auth.evidence: access-token / session auth in server; visibility-based public read.
